caveat.note: TYCTR a is short /a/ as in and — prefer apple, ant, alligator.
TYCTR ē is long /ē/ as in eat — reject short-e pictures.
TYCTR i is short /i/ as in if — reject long-i pictures.
TYCTR th here is voiced /th/ as in this (not thing).
TYCTR o is short /ŏ/ as in ox.
TYCTR u is short /ŭ/ as in under.
TYCTR ā is long /ā/ as in ate — reject short-a pictures.
